description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
同步方向，取值：

- **Forward**：正向。
- **Reverse**：反向。

> - 默认取值为**Forward**。
- 当数据同步实例的拓扑为双向时，才可以传入**Reverse**以清空反向同步链路。
description.en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to reset the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

description.zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用**DescribeSynchronizationJobs**接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the **DescribeSynchronizationJobs** operation to query the instance ID.

descriptions.zh: > 清空数据同步任务配置后，原先的同步任务就会被释放，您需要调用接口**ConfigureSynchronizationJob**重新配置同步任务，才能成功启动该任务。
descriptions.en: > After you reset the configuration of a data synchronization task, the original synchronization task is released. You must call the **ConfigureSynchronizationJob** operation to reconfigure the synchronization task before you can start the task.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts reset-synchronization-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtsm761239l27m0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ResetSynchronizationJob --region cn-hangzhou --SynchronizationJobId dtsm761239l27m0000 --AccountId 123233440000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SynchronizationDirection Forward
